name: For Further Study
summary: Historian Karnik is waiting in Ironforge for a package tied to something epic. What has been seen so far makes further study seem worthwhile.

sections.title: Karnik's Library
sections.body: You are asked to take the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers. He is usually in the library, reading at the back.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the package?
faq.answer: Historian Karnik is waiting for the Whelgar Relic Package in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.
Historian Karnik is usually in the back of the library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.
You are carrying the Whelgar Relic Package for Historian Karnik.

faq.q: Why does this need further study?
faq.answer: The text calls the matter epic and says what has been seen so far makes it seem worthwhile, but gives no further details.
